g.text: Single Unprivileged Host Process (rungv CLI / pkg/gvx Go SDK)
Pre-Opened Host Handles (Only Host Kernel Boundary)
Windows: Restricted Token + Job Object + Mitigation Policies
Multi-Node HA k3s + Calico CNI + etcd
Single UDP Socket (-net=wg) or Host Socket Dialer (-net=nat)
erofs: Immutable OCI Layers (Shared Page Cache)
Virtual NICs: eth0, docker0 Bridge, veth, tun/tap, vxlan
Restricts host OS access before guest start
